In April of 2025, I turned fifty and wanted to mark the year in a meaningful way. So, I took on a challenge: Fifty Acts of Good in Year 50. To hold myself accountable, I documented each act and shared it on social media, hoping others might see a simple gesture of kindness and think, “Oh, I could do that.”

I quickly realized that the acts themselves were only part of the story. They became a catalyst for spending time with the people I love, whether baking for new neighbors, volunteering alongside friends, or tackling projects with family. Along the way, I kept a journal filled with ideas, notes, expenses, photos, and memories.

This app is the framework of that journal, designed to help you track your own journey and create a record of the good you put into the world. Nobody is keeping score. Choose a number that feels right for your life and begin whenever you’re ready.

What good can you spread?

Savannah, GA

Step 1 of 4

First, a bit about you

Your privacy comes first. Everything happens right on your device to calculate your year and draft your posts, we don't collect, track, or share a thing.

Used to work out which year you're marking. That's the word on your card.

Needed only if you want people to be able to accept an invitation. Never sent anywhere by the app.

Step 3 of 4

Where do you post?

Handles are stored on your phone only. The app never logs in or posts for you. It writes the caption with the right handles in it and hands it to you.

Tick the ones you use. Adding your own handle is optional. It's the people you tag that matter, and you'll add them as you go.

Step 4 of 4

Has anyone offered to help?

When people hear what you're doing, some of them offer. Put their names down now. They're easy to forget once they're buried in a comment thread, and they turn into acts.

A place is worth noting, a good few acts happen while you're visiting somewhere.
